Declare numeric position/contact tolerances and hardware before testing; report drift and overload behavior.

larger_game_combinations.name: Expedition Frontier
larger_game_combinations.core: Explore a dangerous region in an assembled vehicle, recover materials and return to a repairable outpost.
larger_game_combinations.first_combined_slice: One expedition route with one vehicle, one salvage objective and one repairable shelter. Add aircraft or space only as separate later products.
larger_game_combinations.reuse_test: Use the same inventory/recipe contract for vehicle repairs and shelter repairs, then verify both consumers.
larger_game_combinations.creative_direction: MudRunner meets Subnautica land-salvage. You custom-build an overland expedition rig (clockwork-courier), drive out from a ramshackle shelter across shifting procedural biomes (living-wilds) and flooded river crossings (storm-harbor), delve into ruins (pocket-expedition), and haul heavy structural salvage back to shore up your base against storms (rescue-demolition).
larger_game_combinations.visual_direction: Gritty-yet-stylized overland adventure—mud accumulating on tires, warm amber headlights cutting through twilight rain, and physical cargo strapped to roof racks.

larger_game_combinations.name: Verdant Foundry
larger_game_combinations.core: Creature-operated production supports a small settlement while squads protect its supply routes.
larger_game_combinations.first_combined_slice: One production chain feeding one district, defended by one squad. Begin solo; add cooperative sessions after the loop is stable.
larger_game_combinations.reuse_test: Share resource accounting across factory, settlement and squads without each inventing a separate wallet.
larger_game_combinations.creative_direction: Pikmin / Palworld creature automation meets They Are Billions settlement defense. Friendly woodland creatures operate conveyor workshops (foundry-friends) that pipe water and goods into a bustling hillside village (pocket-town), while you command tactical squads (bastion-tactics) in solo or 2-player co-op (community-isles) to protect the supply roads.
larger_game_combinations.visual_direction: Bright, readable diorama aesthetic where industrial brass machinery harmonizes with overgrown moss, timber cottages, and expressive creature silhouettes.

larger_game_combinations.name: Isles of Wonder
larger_game_combinations.core: Expressive characters explore traversal routes, solve musical puzzles and resolve consequential island stories.
larger_game_combinations.first_combined_slice: One island, one traversal route, three characters and a single story choice that changes the final musical puzzle.
larger_game_combinations.reuse_test: One event/quest contract consumes both traversal and musical completion events. Patchwork simulation remains optional until it meets the frame budget.
larger_game_combinations.creative_direction: The flagship ShammyVerse 3D adventure. Poofy, Plumpy, and friends glide and climb across vertical island chains (canopy-courier), mediate heartfelt/funny village disputes (paper-council), conduct giant ancient musical organs (echo-stage), and celebrate in physics-driven festival parades (patchwork-parade).
larger_game_combinations.visual_direction: Signature 3-tone cel-shaded cartoon style with crisp outlines, PBR ocean water and sand, squash-and-stretch procedural motion, and a dynamic radio soundtrack.

larger_game_combinations.name: Bastion Extraction
larger_game_combinations.core: A small squad enters a destructible compound, recovers a target and escapes under pressure.
larger_game_combinations.first_combined_slice: One compound with six controllable units, one target and one destructible route. Start offline; network only after authority and replay contracts are proven.
larger_game_combinations.reuse_test: Destruction invalidates navigation and cover through a shared event interface, with recovery tests in both stealth and squad modes.
larger_game_combinations.creative_direction: Commandos / Shadow Tactics meets Rainbow Six breach-and-extract. A 6-unit tactical squad infiltrates a heavily guarded compound (lantern-heist, bastion-tactics), engages elite guards in tight frame-based CQC (duelists-circuit), blows an escape breach directly through a load-bearing compound wall (rescue-demolition), and extracts under networked fire (arena-relay).
larger_game_combinations.visual_direction: High-tension tactical isometric view with real-time dynamic shadow cones, destructible masonry dust clouds, and crisp tactical overlays.
